title: 第十五章 黑客的武器第十六章 第一桶金
content_zh:
最新网址：关羽需要匹配青龙偃月刀，赵云要匹配龙胆亮银枪，而作为黑客的王跃呢，那当然是电脑啊！
王跃洗完澡回来，躺在床上看了看自己的存钱，这些钱勉强够自己的生活费，还不敢浪。
这得想办法挣钱啊！没有钱是万万不行的。可是干点啥呢？
人还是要逼一下，不然，你不知道你的潜力在哪里。在现实世界里，王跃一直想不起来靠啥挣钱，还束手束脚的。
这个时期网游私服应该可能很挣钱，可是这个是犯法的啊！没有写在刑法里的赚钱方式有那些呢？怎么才能先让自己吃好点呢？好怀念酸菜鱼，回锅肉啊，哎，口水出来了。
没想到好办法，王跃决定还是洗洗睡吧。等去网吧看看再说吧。明天还要上课，还是自己陌生的建筑领域。加油，我是全能小王子。
第二天去上课，王跃宿舍一早就到了，占据了第三排靠边的四个位置。正在他翻书的时候，突然感到一阵的骚动。于是抬头向门口一看。
女生402宿舍四个女孩各自有各自的特色，都十分的养眼。她们一进入教室，就引起了不小的躁动。
不过，大家也就躁动了一会，毕竟已经开学好几天了。
只是这次不太一样，女生402宿舍的几个女生，郑微打头，一路直接朝着王跃几个走了过去，并在王跃的身边停了下来。
王跃抬头看了一眼，示意老二张洋他们三个往里面坐。
大家又重新坐好之后，王跃就继续看起书来。结果没看一会，挨着他坐的郑微就用胳膊肘碰他一下？
王跃扭头看着他，郑微从他的头上看到一串的问号，忍不住的就笑了。
她这一笑，王跃的心里毛毛的，于是语气严肃的说，“有事说事，你再使用这美人计，我！我可就从了啊！”
“噗呲！”
“噗呲！”……
周围几个能听到他们他话的，都忍不住乐了。
郑微也被他逗的乐的不行，其实她也没啥事，就是连续这么多天找不到林静，今天她想去林静学校去找找。这会心里实在是安静不下来，就想找人聊聊天。
“就这么个定力啊，你还得练啊！”郑微鄙视的看着王跃，心里不禁得意，看来脸上的这个痘痘，没有影响我那无处安放的魅力。
“是要练练，太容易得到的，都不知道珍惜，所以我要保护我自己。”王跃看着黑板，状似认真听课。随口就接上了郑微的话。

“噗呲！”……
又是笑喷了一片，王跃也是醉了这笑点也太低了，还能不能一起愉快的玩耍了。
郑微看王跃那一本正经的样子，心里却对这趟林静大学的行为，有几分的犹疑。
不过很快的，她又说服了自己。那是她从小到大的梦想，怎么也得去勇敢的面对。
content_en:
The latest website: Guan Yu needs to match the Qinglong Yanyue Sword, Zhao Yun needs to match the Gentian Bright Silver Spear, and as a hacker Wang Yue, of course it is a computer!
Wang Yue came back from taking a shower. He lay on the bed and looked at his savings. The money was barely enough for his living expenses and he didn't dare to waste it.
You have to find a way to make money! It is absolutely impossible to have no money. But what to do?
People still have to push, otherwise, you won’t know where your potential is. In the real world, Wang Yue has never been able to remember how to make money, and he is still tied up.
Private servers of online games should be very profitable during this period, but this is illegal! What are the ways to make money that are not written in the criminal law? How can I make myself eat better first? I really miss the pickled fish and twice-cooked pork. Oh, my mouth is watering.
Unexpectedly, Wang Yue decided to go to bed. Let’s wait until we go to an Internet cafe to check it out. I have class tomorrow, and it is still an unfamiliar field of architecture to me. Come on, I am the almighty little prince.
Going to class the next day, Wang Yue arrived at the dormitory early and occupied four seats in the third row. While he was flipping through the book, he suddenly felt a commotion. Then he looked up at the door.
The four girls in Girls' Dormitory 402 each have their own characteristics and are all very eye-catching. As soon as they entered the classroom, they caused quite a stir.
However, everyone was restless for a while, after all, school had already started for several days.
But this time it was different. Several girls in the girls' dormitory 402, led by Zheng Wei, walked directly towards Wang Yue and others, and stopped beside Wang Yue.
Wang Yue looked up and motioned to Zhang Yang and the three of them to sit inside.
After everyone sat down again, Wang Yue continued to read. After a while, Zheng Wei, who was sitting next to him, nudged him with her elbow?
Wang Yue turned to look at him. Zheng Wei saw a series of question marks on his head and couldn't help but laugh.
Her smile made Wang Yue feel uncomfortable, so he said in a serious tone, "If you have something to say, if you use this honey trap again, I will! I will just obey!"
"Pfft!"
"Pfft!"......
The few people around who could hear what he said couldn't help but be happy.
Zheng Wei was also very amused by him. In fact, she had nothing to do. She just couldn't find Lin Jing for so many days in a row. Today she wanted to go look for Lin Jing's school. I really couldn't calm down at this moment, so I wanted to find someone to chat with.
"It's just such a concentration, you still have to practice it!" Zheng Wei looked at Wang Yue with disdain and couldn't help but feel proud. It seems that the acne on my face has not affected my charm that has nowhere to go.
"You have to practice. If you get it too easily, you don't know how to cherish it, so I have to protect myself." Wang Yue looked at the blackboard, as if he was paying attention to the lecture. He picked up Zheng Wei's words casually.
"Pfft!"......
He burst into laughter again. Wang Yue was also drunk. The point of his laughter was too low. Can we still have fun together?
Zheng Wei looked at Wang Yue's serious look, but felt a little hesitant about Lin Jing's behavior at the university.
But soon, she convinced herself again. That had been her dream since childhood, and she had to face it bravely no matter what.
